title: The displayed Kreisel–Putnam schema changes its third formula name.
details: Printed p.27 (PDF p.29), the list of intermediate logics prints KP using (¬p→q∨r)→((¬p→q)∨(¬p→s)). The last s should be r. As written, choose p=⊥,q=⊥,r=⊤,s=⊥: the premise is classically true and both displayed conclusion disjuncts are false. This is a local variable slip in an adjacent orientation example; the intended Harrop/Kreisel–Putnam schema is standard and the KC/LC arguments selected for the corpus do not use the malformed formula. No upstream correction is inferred.
